docs.title: Production of the Ornament
docs.text:
There's a piece of paper that has survived almost being fed to multiple fires, a photocopied relic: the first pages of a chapter of Ernst Bloch's The Spirit of Utopia.

More than a decade ago, I underlined:

We are poor, we have unlearned how to play. We have forgotten it, our hands have unlearned how to dabble. -p. 10

Since I came to the ecovillage, I've wanted to recycle paper, to re-ponder things I read to quickly by either setting them on fire or making them into mache.

This website can be recycled, replicated, repurposed. Transparent down to the open source code, as much as I can make it. Modular, resilient, sustainable.

docs.text:
If our content publishing platforms are walled gardens, then this is a self-curated seed bank of canonical links. A creative commons of ideas I'd like to spread. The first is this website itself, how easy it is to make. Here are the steps:

  1. Create a Github account
  2. Clone this repository.
  3. Install python and mkdocs.
  4. Edit content
  5. Build and Serve the site locally.
  6. Publish as your own github pages site.

docs.title: Venezuela
docs.text:
My sleep schedule was still off from New Year's, so I was awake at 2am when the Venezuelan military conducted its surgical strike against Washington DC, capturing president Trump and his wife.

It seemed like it must be some kind of a hoax, or like I'd slipped into some kind of alternate reality. For months Maduro had been posturing, blowing up fishing boats off the coast of Florida, claiming they were smuggling drugs. Now, he'd taken his threats and boasting to a level which, even given his sharp decline into the deranged rhetoric of their colonial past, his not-so-subtle evocation of the "raza cozmica" [^1] theory of mestizo superiority, was shockingly surreal.

Helicopters appearing out of nowhere, like they were rising out of the Potomac, missiles ravaging the Ronald Regan airport. Sirens, explosions blooming in the sudden absolute dark, all lights and communication snuffed out except for a single message of violence.

Watching Maduro, with his gang of cabinet members, all of them in the same pose, hands clenched over crotches, chests and chins out, it occurred to me how sexual, how rapey, their language was. Southern Spear. Midnight hammer. Action, penetration, violence.

[^1]: "La Raza Cozmica" is a real book written in 1925 by José Vasconcelos, arguing (if I remember correctly) that Latin Americans are a new, superior, amalgamated race.

docs.title: email:
docs.text:
Dear theatrical aesthetes,

On the evening of the 24th of this month, next Monday, from seven to eight, Tree House Productions at Power Level Zero will be staging a loose adaptation of Act One of The Clouds, written by Aristophanes in 423 BCE.

The play will go from 7-8pm, at the Treehouse. Bring warm clothes and flashlights. Lines will be largely improvised, and the performance will be immediately followed by a meeting where, after check-ins, consensus will be reached on how funny it was (no one is allowed to leave early).

This production of the Clouds will be a loving, self-aware satire of intellectual pretensions, performed by one or more actors, with at least one of the speeches memorized beforehand. There will be lewd and suggestive language, the active questioning of authority, and musical performances. The audience may be participated with, with care and consent.

Rehearsals are optional, and open to the curious, especially if you want to contribute acting, constumes, set design, choreography, or music. It's not too late!

docs.title: Recycling Notes
docs.text:
The role of recyclist can be repurposed and adapted, based on context. There is a squirrel hunched over what might be a black walnut. They come closer, continue. Undignified posture. I'm looking at them through the one door in a wall of windows, which is also a window. Facing West.

I'm thinking of designing a web-page where it asks the user, after some preview text, how curious they are. Then it displays a number of sections, according to their level of interest. The next question might be "how much time do you have?" with a slider bar or choices one through six, and this determines how long each section is, how much hidden text is revealed.

If you are reading this, and your answer is low for either question, then you can safely stop after this paragraph, [executive] summary of what's below.

~

They were a repurposer of worlds. A planet in a suit. Recycled minimalist mobile biome, that did the best it could with loose integrity patterns.

I should have come here with some kind of cue card, a prompt. Instead, it is me, drinking in the late afternoon, sunlight coming through a west-facing window.

It is so hard for me to coordinate and reward the different parts of myself, clamoring for validity and attention, that I despair of the ability of a village, or city, or nation, to do so accurately.

But let this be a performance at the port city of End, a re-imagining of what it means to write, to find an audience.

What am I writing, what am I doing here, what character do I play?

I am a human, and it is important to leave a verifiable trace for some of the stories, the narratives, that are about to unfold, apparently from various sources.

If you are going to stick around for a while, while I finish this beer and type these words, here is my roadmap, my plan:

  1. Ideal Community [#ideal-community]
  2. Metagame
  3. Treehouse
  4. Community Garden
  5. Playing Cards

Cardboard pedestal in an abandoned ball-room loved by vines and itinerant critters.

I live in a insular community, where you have to watch carefully the things you say. I have always insisted on writing to people I like, not those who have power over me. These messages will not be crafted with the purpose of improving my financial or social positioning, to jostle shoulders with keepers of gates and paper fences.

My ideal audience isn't crowded with stranger's whose contexts and perspectives and interpretive codes for language are necessarily alien and inscrutable, but rather a small group of friends and close second order associates, a network glowing at the edges.

docs.title: Power
docs.text:
You grant legitimacy to systems by challenging them within the systems, using the tools they provide, with no access to the root layers.

It's all about the genre, the tone, the selected media and licenses to broadcast.

The revolution will not be

between clear lines of battle
